audience: property managers who run rentals and work orders in Buildium

useCases.title: Find tenants who owe rent
useCases.text: The AI reads the outstanding balances report: total owed and the 0-30, 31-60, 61-90 and 90+ day buckets per lease. It adds the tenants from the lease and flags eviction-pending ones.

useCases.title: Check which leases end soon
useCases.text: The AI lists active leases for a property or owner and reads the dates, tenants and lease type. You get the leases to renew or fill, sorted by end date.

useCases.title: Review open work orders by priority
useCases.text: The AI lists work orders by status, priority, vendor, unit or due date. It shows what is high priority, overdue or not yet billed.

useCases.title: Create a work order for a vendor
useCases.text: The AI creates a work order for a vendor on an existing task, or with a new task. It can add line items with a quantity and an optional GL account.

useCases.title: Update to-do tasks and work orders
useCases.text: The AI marks to-do tasks as completed or changes their priority, assignee or due date. It can also change a work order's details without losing its line items.
